errors.text_span: Секторът, обозначен с оранжево, представлява „индустрия“ и заема съответно 8%, 21% и 33% от всяка диаграма.
errors.evidence: According to the legend and the chart, industry is yellow/gold, not orange; 8%, 21%, and 33% correspond to different categories across the three charts, not industry in all three.

errors.text_span: Секторът, обозначен с червено, представлява „строителство“ и заема 12%, 31% и 6% от всяка диаграма.
errors.evidence: In the figure, red corresponds to trade, while construction is blue. The percentages 12%, 31%, and 6% do not belong to construction across the charts.

errors.text_span: Секторът, обозначен с тъмносиньо, представлява „търговия“ и заема 19%, 19% и 31% от всяка диаграма.
errors.evidence: Dark blue corresponds to other services, not trade. The 19%, 19%, and 31% values are associated with trade in the charts, but the color/category mapping is wrong.

errors.text_span: Секторът, обозначен с тъмносиньо, представлява „други услуги“ и заема 61%, 51% и 33% от всяка диаграма.
errors.evidence: Other services is shown in dark blue, but the percentages listed are not all correct for that category: 61%, 51%, and 33% correspond to different sectors/charts, and the statement also duplicates dark blue for two different categories.

errors.text_span: Всяка диаграма изглежда подредена в низходящ ред на размера на сектора.
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered in descending size; the chart explicitly shows the sectors in a fixed color/order arrangement, and the reference notes they are not visually sorted by size.
The description does not clearly state that the chart shows the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021.
The description omits that the figure has no axes but includes legend-based categorical encoding and in-slice labels with percentages and absolute values.
